info.title: Bakin API
info.description: Generated OpenAPI contract for Bakin core and official plugin HTTP routes.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Centralized content store for all artifacts with rich rendering, search, task linking, manual upload, and clipboard paste

tags.name: Health
tags.description: System health dashboard — MCP stats, diagnostics, and uptime

tags.name: Memory
tags.description: Observability dashboard over runtime memory tiers plus Bakin's audit log

tags.name: Messaging
tags.description: Content messaging with scheduling, brainstorming, and multi-agent content pipeline

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Agent model configuration — per-agent models, aliases, task profiles, available models from Anthropic API

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Project management with specs, checklists, task linking, and agent access via MCP tools

tags.name: Schedule
tags.description: Cron job scheduling through the runtime adapter with task creation

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Kanban task management with Bakin task-store persistence, agent assignment, and dependency tracking

tags.name: Team
tags.description: Agent team management — adapter layer over runtime agent workspaces

tags.name: Workflows
tags.description: Workflow runtime — enforces step-by-step agent execution with gated delivery, parallel steps, human gates, and output validation
